en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan Al Maysami, from Ibrahim Bin Mihzam, from a man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, whenever the meal was raised, said: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! You<sup>azwj</sup> Made it plentiful, and pleasant, and Blessed, so You<sup>azwj</sup> have satiated us, and quenched us. The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who Feeds and is not fed’.
en.sarwar: 15. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Ahmad ibn al-Hassan al-Mithamiy from Ibrahim ibn Mehzam from a man who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has stated this Hadith. ‘

The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, when the table was moved would say, “O Lord, you have granted a great deal, have made it very good, blessed it, made us satisfied and quenched. All praise belongs to Allah who feeds and is not fed.’””
